generation.result_format: documented expected rows; not external execution

cases.name: named_window_qualify_alias
cases.sql: SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ranked AS row_number FROM sales WINDOW ranked AS (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY amount DESC, id) QUALIFY row_number = 1 ORDER BY id

cases.name: qualify_only_window
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM sales QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY amount DESC, id) = 1 ORDER BY id

cases.name: group_having_window_qualify_distinct
cases.sql: SELECT DISTINCT SUM(amount) AS total, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM sales GROUP BY region HAVING SUM(amount) >= 50 QUALIFY sales_rank = 1 ORDER BY total
